capabilities: Insert thread separators manually or automatically
Show fragment order and character counts while typing
Send single posts or whole threads to a Mastodon server
Convert links to Mastodon posts into quotes
extras: First use requires an OAuth connection to the user's Mastodon server; the plugin stores only the tokens it receives. Direct visibility is not supported. The author describes it as a side project without guaranteed maintenance, and only some interface languages are translated.
motivation: Making threads by hand is tedious, so the author wanted Obsidian's editing capabilities used to prepare thread snippets and send them to the server automatically.
problem: Posting a long Mastodon thread means copying text and images into the Mastodon client one post at a time.

relations.evidence: Thanks to Ryō Igarashi for maintaining the masto.js library.

summary: Splits a note into thread fragments with separators and posts them, with media and descriptions, to a Mastodon server.
